file_name: Holcim Australia - Burdetts Group - third-party questionnaire - 10 August 2026_0.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Holcim and Burdett’s are close competitors in the supply of sand and hard rock aggregates in Southeast Victoria and RMX in Langwarrin, and identify alternative suppliers or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the impact of the Acquisition on competition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Holcim and/or Burdett’s.
